judgement.reason: The passages state RFC 9110 was published in June 2022 and that its section 9.2.2 classifies PUT as idempotent.

units.text: Section 9.2.2 of RFC 9110 explicitly states that PUT, DELETE, and safe request methods are idempotent.

units.text: RFC 9110 was published as an Internet Standard in June 2022, establishing it as the definitive HTTP standard at that time.

judgement.reason: The passages support that RFC 9110 was published in June 2022 as Internet Standard STD 97 and obsoletes several earlier HTTP RFCs, but they do not state that it was the definitive HTTP standard at that time.
